correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite k,n the equivalence between equality of both box compositions and rectangular occupied connected components is established by recovering relational successor sets from Boolean powerset operators. The distinguished-left-vertex recurrence enumerates these graphs and onto Stirling counts enumerate samples exactly. At n~t*k^(2/3), labelled P4 triples have mean n^3/k^2, and the strict balanced overlap estimates give Poisson(t^3); repeated corners and full rectangles disappear. For k^(2/3)<<n<<k^2, variance O(n^3/k^2+n^5/k^4+n^4/k^3) plus expected spoiled-corner fraction O(n/k^2) forces a witness. For n>>k log k cut counting gives connectedness whp; below 2*k^2 log k empty cells exist whp by negative covariance; at n=k^2(2 log k+s+o(1)) factorial moments of empty cells give Poisson(e^-s), and above it all cells fill whp. Every range, quantifier and boundary was checked, including vacant labels and duplicate samples. Executed extracted verifier.py returned VERIFY_OK for 12842 assignments, EXACT_COUNT_OK for 12 finite count cases and 6 corner-probability identities. These computations verify finite premises, not limits.

originality.rationale: The exact finite enumeration and rectangular characterization are already implied by an accessible earlier class-refined commuting-equivalence generating function and general relational facts; this result explicitly excludes both from its originality claim. The new claim is the paired critical asymptotics e^-t^3 and exp(-e^-s), with a rigorous zero-probability gap and return to certainty, for independent uniform label-pair epistemic frames. The 2023 original paper treats commutativity as a logical interaction axiom, with no probabilistic two-window law in its examined relevant sections. Literature and comparable earlier mathematical results showed adjacent but not covering asymptotic claims. Generic P4 Poisson and occupancy techniques may have stronger general forms; priority remains qualified.

value.rationale: Knowledge commutativity is a natural agent-interaction axiom investigated for decidable epistemic planning. Under an explicit natural random finite two-agent model, it vanishes at a sparse P4-collision window, stays almost surely false across many density orders, and returns to almost sure truth at complete occupancy; distinct limit curves e^{-t^3} and exp(-e^{-s}) give quantitatively sharp boundaries. This separates modal logical structure from simple random partition statistics and is a meaningful complete characterization of the probability phase diagram, not a trivial substitution. The exact finite formula is supporting reproducibility, not the primary novel value.
